_comment: NIST SP 800-171A determination statements (the real 320 assessment objectives across all 110 CMMC L2 practices). Generated from tenant-tests/profiles/nist-800-171a-objectives.json (G-EUT-5 Phase 3). One entry per determination statement [a][b][c]..., each tagged with its required assessment method(s). Replaces the prior synthetic one-Examine-objective-per-control stub so the SSP maps to real objectives, not 110 practices.
